# machine-ui

> A theming-first design system on shadcn/ui and Radix. Components install as source through the shadcn CLI. A theme engine generates colour, type, spacing, corners and motion from a few personality settings, and solves every colour pair for WCAG 2.2 contrast in light and dark.

Add the registry once (see the install guide), then install components with `npx shadcn@latest add <items>`.

## Docs

- [Install guide](/install.md): add the registry, a theme, fonts and components
- [Full reference](/llms-full.txt): props and example code for every component
- [Themes](/themes): generate a theme and export CSS, JSON or a theme brief

## Rules

- Build interfaces from these components; do not hand-roll equivalents.
- Style with semantic tokens only (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `var(--primary)`): no raw colours, px values, gradients or font names.
- Pair every surface with its `-foreground` token; use `text-link` for coloured text. These pairs are contrast-solved.
- Use the spacing scale and `h-(--control-sm|md|lg)` for control heights, `rounded-sm|md|lg|xl` for corners.
- Keep keyboard access, visible focus and labels: icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
- JavaScript-driven motion (charts, streaming text) must respect `useReducedMotion()`.

## Components

### Forms and inputs

- [Button](/components/button): Triggers an action. Six variants and four sizes, with icon, loading and disabled states. Install: `@machine-ui/button`
- [Button Group](/components/button-group): Joins related buttons into one row with shared edges, including split buttons. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/button-group`
- [Calendar](/components/calendar): A month grid for picking a single date or a range, with today marked and keyboard navigation. Install: `@machine-ui/calendar`
- [Checkbox](/components/checkbox): Turns an option on or off. Supports an indeterminate state for "some selected". Install: `@machine-ui/checkbox @machine-ui/label`
- [Combobox](/components/combobox): A select with a filter field: type to narrow the options, then pick one. Install: `@machine-ui/combobox @machine-ui/label`
- [Copy Input](/components/copy-input): A read-only field with a copy button, for API keys, webhook URLs and share links. Install: `@machine-ui/copy-input @machine-ui/label`
- [Date Picker](/components/date-picker): A button that opens a Calendar and shows the chosen date in short form. Install: `@machine-ui/date-picker @machine-ui/label`
- [Field](/components/field): Lays out a label, control, help text and error for one form field, so every form reads the same way. Install: `@machine-ui/field @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/switch`
- [Input](/components/input): A single-line text field, with invalid and disabled states. Install: `@machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label`
- [Input Group](/components/input-group): A text field with a fixed prefix, suffix or icon inside one border. Install: `@machine-ui/input-group @machine-ui/label`
- [Input OTP](/components/input-otp): Single-character boxes for a one-time code. Focus moves forward as each box fills, and pasting works. Install: `@machine-ui/input-otp @machine-ui/label`
- [Label](/components/label): A text label for a form control. Clicking it focuses the control it names. Install: `@machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label`
- [Native Select](/components/native-select): The browser’s own select, styled to match the theme. Best on mobile and for long option lists. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/native-select`
- [Radio Group](/components/radio-group): A set of options where exactly one is selected. Arrow keys move the selection. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/radio-group`
- [Search Input](/components/search-input): A search field with a shortcut hint, and a clear button once there is a value. Install: `@machine-ui/search-input`
- [Select](/components/select): A dropdown for picking one value from a short list, with groups and separators. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/select`
- [Slider](/components/slider): Picks a number, or a range, by dragging. Arrow keys step through values. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/slider`
- [Switch](/components/switch): Turns a setting on or off immediately, without a save step. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/switch`
- [Textarea](/components/textarea): A multi-line text field that resizes vertically. Use it for messages, notes and descriptions. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/textarea`
- [Toggle](/components/toggle): A button that stays pressed, for one on/off option such as a filter or formatting. Install: `@machine-ui/toggle`
- [Toggle Group](/components/toggle-group): A joined row of toggles for picking one option, or several, from a small set. Install: `@machine-ui/toggle-group`

### Overlays

- [Alert Dialog](/components/alert-dialog): A modal that interrupts to confirm a consequential action. It only closes through its buttons or Escape. Install: `@machine-ui/alert-dialog @machine-ui/button`
- [Command](/components/command): A searchable list of actions with groups and shortcuts. Use CommandDialog to open it as a palette. Install: `@machine-ui/command`
- [Command Palette](/components/command-palette): Command in a modal, opened from a button or a shortcut. Typing filters, arrows move, Enter runs, Escape closes. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/command @machine-ui/kbd`
- [Context Menu](/components/context-menu): A menu of actions that opens at the pointer when its area is right-clicked or long-pressed. Install: `@machine-ui/context-menu`
- [Dialog](/components/dialog): A modal window over the page. Focus moves inside, Escape closes it and focus returns to the trigger. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/dialog @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label`
- [Drawer](/components/drawer): A bottom sheet with a drag handle, for mobile-first flows. Swipe down or press Escape to close. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/drawer`
- [Dropdown Menu](/components/dropdown-menu): A menu of actions below a trigger, with icons, shortcuts, checkbox items, submenus and a destructive style. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/dropdown-menu`
- [Hover Card](/components/hover-card): A floating preview shown while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, its trigger. Install: `@machine-ui/avatar @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/hover-card`
- [Popover](/components/popover): A floating panel anchored to a trigger, for short forms, settings and details. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label @machine-ui/popover`
- [Sheet](/components/sheet): A panel that slides in from any edge over a scrim. Good for edit forms and detail views. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label @machine-ui/sheet`
- [Tooltip](/components/tooltip): A short label shown on hover or focus. Never put essential information only in a tooltip. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/tooltip`

### Navigation

- [Breadcrumb](/components/breadcrumb): Shows where a page sits in the hierarchy, with a collapsed middle for long trails. Install: `@machine-ui/breadcrumb`
- [Menubar](/components/menubar): A row of menus like a desktop app bar. Open one, then arrow or hover across the others. Install: `@machine-ui/menubar`
- [Navigation Menu](/components/navigation-menu): Site navigation with dropdown panels of links, for marketing sites and docs. Install: `@machine-ui/navigation-menu`
- [Pagination](/components/pagination): Moves through pages of results with numbered links, previous and next. Install: `@machine-ui/pagination`
- [Sidebar](/components/sidebar): App navigation that collapses to icons on desktop and becomes a sheet on mobile. Ctrl/⌘+B toggles it. Install: `@machine-ui/sidebar`
- [Stepper](/components/stepper): Progress through a fixed sequence of steps, with done, current and upcoming states. Install: `@machine-ui/stepper`
- [Tabs](/components/tabs): Switches between views in the same context. Arrow keys move between tabs. Install: `@machine-ui/tabs`

### Data display

- [Avatar](/components/avatar): Shows a person as a photo or initials, alone or as an overlapping group. Install: `@machine-ui/avatar`
- [Badge](/components/badge): A small label for state or category, in primary, secondary, outline and destructive styles. Install: `@machine-ui/badge`
- [Card](/components/card): Groups related content on a raised surface. Whether it uses a border or a shadow comes from the theme’s separation setting. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/card`
- [Chart](/components/chart): Recharts with theme colours, gridlines and tooltips. Series colours come from the chart tokens. Install: `@machine-ui/chart @machine-ui/use-reduced-motion`
- [Data Table](/components/data-table): A table with sorting, filtering, row selection and pagination, built on TanStack Table. Install: `@machine-ui/badge @machine-ui/data-table`
- [Item](/components/item): A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists, settings and search results. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/item @machine-ui/switch`
- [Kbd](/components/kbd): Shows a keyboard key or shortcut in a small keycap. Install: `@machine-ui/kbd`
- [Stat](/components/stat): A labelled number with an optional change, marked up or down by icon and text, not colour alone. Install: `@machine-ui/card @machine-ui/stat`
- [Table](/components/table): Composable table parts for simple tabular data. Use Data Table when you need sorting or selection. Install: `@machine-ui/badge @machine-ui/table`
- [Typography](/components/typography): Text styles on the theme’s fluid type scale: headings use the display face, body uses the text face. Install: `@machine-ui/typography`

### Feedback and status

- [Alert](/components/alert): An inline banner with a title and a description, in default, success, warning and destructive variants. Install: `@machine-ui/alert`
- [Empty](/components/empty): A placeholder for a view with nothing in it yet: what it is for, and the one action to start. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/empty`
- [Progress](/components/progress): Shows how far a task with a known length has come. Install: `@machine-ui/label @machine-ui/progress`
- [Skeleton](/components/skeleton): Placeholder blocks that hold the shape of content while it loads. Install: `@machine-ui/skeleton`
- [Spinner](/components/spinner): A spinning ring for work with no known length. Announced to screen readers as loading. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/spinner`
- [Status Dot](/components/status-dot): A small coloured dot for presence and health, always paired with a text label. Install: `@machine-ui/status-dot`
- [Toast](/components/toast): Short, temporary messages in a stack. Mount one Toaster near the root and call toast() from anywhere. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/sonner`

### Layout and utility

- [Accordion](/components/accordion): A stack of headings that each reveal a section. One or several sections can be open. Install: `@machine-ui/accordion`
- [Aspect Ratio](/components/aspect-ratio): Keeps media at a fixed shape as its width changes. Install: `@machine-ui/aspect-ratio`
- [Carousel](/components/carousel): A row of slides with previous and next buttons, swipe, and arrow-key support. Install: `@machine-ui/card @machine-ui/carousel`
- [Collapsible](/components/collapsible): A single trigger that shows or hides the content beneath it. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/collapsible`
- [Resizable](/components/resizable): Panels the user can resize by dragging, or with arrow keys on the focused handle. Install: `@machine-ui/resizable`
- [Scroll Area](/components/scroll-area): A fixed-height container that scrolls its content with a thin, theme-coloured scrollbar. Install: `@machine-ui/scroll-area @machine-ui/separator`
- [Separator](/components/separator): A hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical. Install: `@machine-ui/separator`

### AI elements

- [Agent Glyph](/components/agent-glyph): The agent’s mark, used as its avatar beside messages and activity. Takes the theme’s primary colour. Install: `@machine-ui/agent-glyph`
- [Approval Card](/components/approval-card): The agent asks before it acts: a question, a few options and Confirm or Skip. Install: `@machine-ui/approval-card`
- [Citations](/components/citation): Numbered markers in an answer that preview their source, and the list of sources underneath. Install: `@machine-ui/citation`
- [Code Block](/components/code-block): Code with a filename header and a copy button, for agent output and docs. Install: `@machine-ui/code-block`
- [Confidence Bar](/components/confidence-bar): How sure the agent is, as a bar plus a word (high, medium, low), so colour is never the only signal. Install: `@machine-ui/confidence-bar`
- [Message](/components/message): One turn in a conversation. User turns sit right in a bubble; assistant turns read as plain text with actions. Install: `@machine-ui/agent-glyph @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/message`
- [Prompt Input](/components/prompt-input): The composer: auto-growing text, tools and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and it becomes a stop button while the agent works. Install: `@machine-ui/button @machine-ui/prompt-input`
- [Streaming Text](/components/streaming-text): Types a response out with a cursor, then hides the cursor. Shows the whole text at once under reduced motion. Install: `@machine-ui/streaming-text`
- [Thinking Indicator](/components/thinking-indicator): A short label with pulsing dots while the agent works. Announced politely; still when motion is off. Install: `@machine-ui/thinking`
- [Thinking Steps](/components/thinking-steps): The steps an agent is working through, with done, active and upcoming states. Install: `@machine-ui/thinking`
- [Tool Call](/components/tool-call): A tool the agent called, with its status and, on demand, its input and output. Install: `@machine-ui/tool-call`

## Themes

- [console](/r/theme-console.json): IBM Plex Mono + IBM Plex Sans; warm greys; the default. Install: `@machine-ui/theme-console`
- [graphite](/r/theme-graphite.json): Geist; cool greys. Install: `@machine-ui/theme-graphite`
- [harbor](/r/theme-harbor.json): Public Sans; cool greys. Install: `@machine-ui/theme-harbor`
- [folio](/r/theme-folio.json): Instrument Serif + Instrument Sans; neutral greys. Install: `@machine-ui/theme-folio`
- [bloom](/r/theme-bloom.json): Bricolage Grotesque + Figtree; warm greys. Install: `@machine-ui/theme-bloom`
- [forge](/r/theme-forge.json): Archivo Black + Archivo; neutral greys. Install: `@machine-ui/theme-forge`
